summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. All 49 backend pytest tests pass (33 regression + 16 new for Categories CRUD, Admin Newsletter list/export/delete, Upload storage status). All new frontend flows pass: dynamic SEO head tags on Home/Games/dApps/Blog/detail pages (og:type correctly toggles website vs article, title suffixed with ' · EtherAuthority Interns', og:image set on detail pages), admin sidebar Categories/Newsletter links visible, /admin/categories full CRUD (add/edit/delete with correct testids, tab switching between game/dapp/blog), /admin/newsletter subscriber list + CSV download triggered successfully (file: newsletter-subscribers-*.csv), Game & dApp forms use <select> CategorySelect with options loaded from /api/categories?type=..., new game saved successfully via dropdown category and persisted in DB.

issues: Testid inconsistency: blog form uses `admin-blog-category` (singular) while game/dapp forms use `admin-games-category` / `admin-dapps-category` (plural). The review request wording 'admin-<route>-category' implies plural since route is /admin/blogs. Not breaking, but tests that assume plural pattern will miss the blog category. Suggest renaming to `admin-blogs-category` for consistency (or documenting the exception).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Rename BlogForm testids from admin-blog-* to admin-blogs-* for consistency with games/dapps forms (currently admin-blog-title, admin-blog-category, admin-blog-save, admin-blog-form, admin-blog-editor, admin-blog-status, admin-blog-excerpt, admin-blog-featured, admin-blog-upload-thumb, admin-blog-upload-banner).
critical_code_review_comments: storage.js uses top-level `await import('cloudinary')` inside an ESM module - this only works because server.js uses type: module. Fine.

categories.js: `slug` in update path is regenerated only if name provided OR slug provided; if user updates only `type` with same name+slug that already exists on new type, still handled by unique constraint (returns 409). Good.
newsletter admin CSV escapes quotes correctly with the double-quote replacement; header row is quoted ("email","subscribedAt") which some strict CSV parsers may complain about but is RFC-4180 valid.
useSEO hook removes meta tags when content is falsy which can cause meta[og:image] to disappear on navigation from a page with image to one without. Acceptable behavior but worth noting.
Categories.jsx uses window.confirm() for delete which is fine but breaks headless test flows by default - Playwright test handled it via page.on('dialog', accept).
Newsletter.jsx exportCsv uses fetch directly with BACKEND_URL and reads localStorage 'ea_token'. Works but duplicates auth logic; could use the shared API axios instance with responseType 'blob'.
BlogForm.jsx testids use 'admin-blog-*' while ProjectAdminForm uses 'admin-<route>-*' (route=games/dapps). Minor inconsistency.
